title: STEM Idea Adventure
subtitle: Interactive Learning Platform
description: AI-powered STEM idea generator that creates personalized science experiments, engineering challenges, and learning paths for K-12 students using multi-agent AI.
longDescription: STEM Idea Adventure reimagines science education through interactive challenges, 3D simulations, and game-like progression systems. Built for K-12 students, it makes complex concepts feel like an adventure.

title: Mahina OS
subtitle: Experimental OS Interface
description: A reimagined operating system interface — brutally minimal, intentionally different. MahinaOS is an experimental OS-shell aesthetic built for those who think modern computing has gotten too comfortable.
longDescription: MahinaOS is a radical rethink of the computing interface — stripped of corporate polish, rebuilt around intentionality. A fully interactive OS-shell aesthetic that challenges what a desktop environment can feel like.

title: AEGIS
subtitle: AI Decision Intelligence Platform
description: AI decision intelligence platform that orchestrates agentic data pipelines on BigQuery and Vertex AI — turning raw enterprise data into structured, evidence-based strategic decisions.
longDescription: AEGIS orchestrates agentic data pipelines on BigQuery and Vertex AI, combining multi-model reasoning with enterprise data warehousing to produce structured, evidence-based strategic decisions at scale.

title: Veronica AI
subtitle: Conversational AI System
description: A next-generation conversational AI system with custom agent orchestration, persistent memory graphs, and emotionally adaptive dialogue — built to feel genuinely intelligent.
longDescription: Veronica is a next-generation AI system built with custom agent orchestration, persistent memory graphs, and emotionally responsive dialogue models. It powers conversational experiences that feel genuinely intelligent.
